_doc: GUNSLINGER legs (steampunk_robot.glb). World after import: Z up (0.33..1.95), X = width, Y = front/back. The body mesh (material Mech) holds both legs as two columns below the hips at z 0.97 (left x -0.30..-0.11, right 0.16..0.36, the gap centred on x 0.025). The forearms are their own mesh (material Arms) and must stay one object named Object_158 (enemy_gunslinger.gd splits it by side at spawn for the gun-arm), so they are claimed first by material. tools/blender/split_regions.py
